description: This file defines the KeyIdMap class, which manages a thread-safe mapping between session IDs and key IDs within the firebolt::rialto::client namespace. It provides methods to add, update, retrieve, and erase key session data, and enforces singleton pattern constraints.

classes.name: KeyIdMap
classes.description: A singleton class that manages a thread-safe map of session IDs to key IDs.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of KeyIdMap.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Adds a new session ID to the map.

methods.name: updateKey
methods.description: Updates the key ID associated with a session ID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the key ID associated with a session ID.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes a session ID and its associated key ID from the map.
